answer.instructions: Which smart home device should handle this voice command?

criteria.lights: Ceiling lights and lamps: switching them on or off and changing their brightness
criteria.thermostat: Heating and cooling: the room temperature and the heating schedule
criteria.door_lock: The smart locks on the doors: locking, unlocking and checking their status
criteria.speaker: The speakers: playing music or podcasts and changing the volume
criteria.blinds: The motorised blinds and curtains: opening and closing them
criteria.tv: The television: switching channels, starting shows and sports
